india.one_line: Indian enterprises scale AI adoption while Nasscom warns that automation threatens entry-level technology jobs.

themes.title: AI threatens entry-level tech jobs
themes.text: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warned that AI automation of entry-level coding could threaten technology jobs for recent engineering graduates.

stories.headline: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warns AI may impact tech jobs for graduates

themes.title: Businesses move to full-scale production
themes.text: Oracle India reported that Indian businesses have shifted from AI pilot tests to full-scale enterprise production over the past year and a half.

stories.headline: Oracle India says firms are moving from AI pilots to full-scale production
